scripts.setup: npm ci && uv sync --project backend --frozen && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @spotter/web && uv run --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @spotter/web && npm exec --workspace @spotter/web -- tsc -p ../tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.test: uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml && npm run test --workspace @spotter/web
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py migrate
scripts.api:schema: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py spectacular --file backend/openapi.yaml --validate --fail-on-warn
scripts.api:generate: npm run api:schema && npm run api:types
scripts.check:django: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py check && uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run check:django && npm test && npm run api:check && npm run build
